title: •Watto
caption: •Watto (V)
game_text: “Free” on You’re A Slave? is treated as “2 Force.” Once per turn, may shuffle Reserve Deck and draw destiny. If destiny is odd, for remainder of turn your Force drains at {episode1} sites are +1; if even, may take card drawn into hand.
lore: Toydarian junk dealer. Skilled *gambler*. Won Shmi and Anakin in a Podrace bet with Gardulla the Hutt. Jedi mind tricks don’t work on him, only money.

notes: Group: Everything else (sheet page 'Virtual Set 16: Everything else', DARK SIDE). Unique (•). Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 2 / empty third box (printed as on Watto); deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (as printed). No column icons. Alien (DS alien frame). Inline black EPISODE I circle in 'Force drains at [icon] sites' → {episode1} (stub 'Episode I sites'). Curly double quotes “Free” / “2 Force.” and You’re (stub straight single quotes). CREDITS: 'Original concept by Blake Huffman' printed under the text box at the LEFT; 'Justin Warren Memorial Tourney 2005' is printed in the bottom black strip between the caption and the number (not under the text box) — recorded as credit_bottom [left, right]; the renderer may need to place the right one in the caption strip. Lore: 'gambler' printed BOLD on the 350 px scan → *gambler*; curly apostrophe in don’t; wording matches the wiki. Ring: Tatooine sphere with the Episode I icon below it → ring_icons ['episode1']. Base scan only at 350 px (Tat-D-watto_ai.gif is the AI version, not used); copyright not legible — Tatooine 2001 line per the brief. Modern: VB5 -pre (350) only.
